title: The Link That Dropped: Reconnecting to a Robot With a Delay That Grows, and Only Once for Each Drop
fallback: This lesson is about a network connection that fails and is retried, so it needs Qt Network. Lesson 07-06 is about waiting without spinning, and lesson 08-13 about a cable that comes out, in plain C++. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: a client of a TCP link that reconnects with a growing delay, once for each failure, and gives up when told to stop
